title: When Dimple Met Rishi
author: Sandhya Menon
blurb: Have you ever ended up in the same class as your crush? Well, what happens when Rishi, a hopeless romantic, joins the same summer coding camp as Dimple, all because their parents have marriage plans of their own? There's just one catch: Dimple may be many things: headstrong, opinionated, and a little prickly, but a hopeless romantic she certainly isn't! Let's see if a summer at coding camp can change a thing or two.
